title: SAFARI: A Community-Engaged Approach and Dataset of Stereotype Resources in the Sub-Saharan African Context

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring stereotype endorsement using a Natural Language Inference (NLI) based technique, which checks if a generative AI model infers stereotypical attributes from a premise containing specific ethnic or tribal identity terms.
Measuring stereotype endorsement using an NLI-based technique to evaluate whether models incorrectly infer stereotypical traits from sentences invoking gender-based identity terms.

Measuring stereotype endorsement using an NLI-based technique to test if models infer negative stereotypical attributes (e.g., 'corrupt', 'liar') from identity terms related to specific professions (e.g., police, politicians, nurses).
Measuring stereotype endorsement using an NLI-based technique to evaluate if models infer local stereotypes based on regional identities within Sub-Saharan African countries.
Measuring stereotype endorsement using an NLI-based technique to assess whether models propagate stereotypes about specific racial groups, particularly prominent in the South African dataset.
Measuring stereotype endorsement using an NLI-based technique to evaluate models' tendencies to infer stereotypical traits from nationality identity terms.
Measuring stereotype endorsement using an NLI-based technique to evaluate if models associate religious identity terms with stereotypical attributes.
